title: VEO 2 might have huge potential in game dev (GTA San Andreas)
author: Sad-Ambassador-9040

comments.author: DreamNotDeferred
comments.body: ...can you provide some more info? What do you mean?

replies.author: Sad-Ambassador-9040
replies.body: this is generated using googles veo 2 video generation tool (via playjump) - i was wondering if it might have some real world video game dev usage in the near future

replies.author: gremblinz
replies.body: How? It’s a video? Do you work in gamedev or something? Generative ai will impact gamedev in terms of generating models, code, etc, but how is a video model going to impact a devs workflow?

replies.author: Sad-Ambassador-9040
replies.body: animation - would help in visualization of scenes before hand too

comments.author: Nucleif
comments.body: What has video todo with game dev?

replies.author: newcarrots69
replies.body: Video games technically just produce video.

comments.author: surpurdurd
comments.body: It's just pure hallucination. It's very cool, but I don't think this type of tech will see much use outside of upscaling and concepting. You can't rely on hallucinations for things like UI, where the accurate and clear conveyance of information is the point.
